d:
Go behind the camera with the Maasi vlog Join Gippy Grewal and Shehnaaz Gill on the sets of Singh vs Kaur 2 for the fun, the madness and the unseen moments behind one of the film's most entertaining songs.
Maasi, sung by Gippy Grewal with lyrics by Veet Baljit, is a fresh remix by Kulshan Sandhu of Jatinder Shah's original music, and the energy on set is just as high as the song itself
Which moment from the vlog was your favourite? Tell us below
Song Credits
Song: Maasi
Singer: Gippy Grewal
Lyrics: Veet Baljit
Music: Jatinder Shah (Original)
